title: asq Office capabilities
description: The body of GET /api/capabilities (backend-v1.4.md §4): which contract revisions this back-end speaks, which features are wired, what each provider can actually observe and drive, and how each service answered when last checked. The client asks once at start-up and again after a reconnect; it never infers a capability from the presence or absence of a field.

contract_revision.description: The revision this back-end prefers and the one its 1.4 routes expect in X-Office-Contract.

supported_contract_revisions.description: Every revision still served, oldest first, including contract_revision. A back-end that kept the v1.3 read path reports ["1.3", "1.4"].

artifact_revision.description: The manifest.json revision of the schema/fixture artifact this back-end was built against, or null when it was not built from a pinned pack.

features.description: Every feature id in FeatureId appears exactly once, whether enabled or not. A missing entry is a contract violation, not a disabled feature.

services.description: Exactly the four service ids, each once.

ContractRevision.description: Wire revisions within major v:1. The major never moves for an additive revision.

FeatureId.description: Finite. A back-end that cannot do something reports it here with enabled:false and a reason; it never omits the entry and never invents a new id.

reason.description: Why it is off, in one bounded sentence. Null exactly when enabled is true.

ProviderId.description: The agent provider a session runs on, e.g. claude. Open so a second provider can be added without a revision, but each entry appears once.

observation.description: What evidence the back-end really has. pane_only means no hook evidence, so a Question from this provider carries detected_by "frame" and may lag; it does not mean the provider is broken.

structured_input.description: Whether a prompt on this provider can be answered with an option key and a keystroke plan. False means the GUI must send the user to the terminal, exactly as no_gui_answer already does.

reason.description: Null when observation is hooks_and_pane and structured_input is true.

ServiceId.description: The four services of SHARED.md. cli is local and always present; the other three are independently available.

detail.description: One bounded sentence. Never an endpoint carrying a key, a credential or a filesystem path.

checked_at.description: When this status was established. Null when the service was never reached — which is not the same as reaching it and finding it down.
